bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using SEAT (Sentence Encoder Association Test for sentence-level associations), CrowS-Pairs (comparing model probabilities assigned to stereotyped versus anti-stereotyped sentences), and StereoSet (cloze tests measuring model preferences for stereotypes, anti-stereotypes, and unrelated choices).
Evaluated using a ternary attribute setting (Judaism, Christianity, and Islam) and assessed via word embedding manifold visualizations and overall performance on comprehensive bias benchmarks.

Measured using the overall, multi-domain test sets of the CrowS-Pairs and StereoSet benchmarks, which evaluate broad stereotyping behaviors across various protected groups (such as race and profession).
